description: This file contains implementation for a compressed bitmap data structure using the EWAH (Efficient Word-Aligned Hybrid) compression method, including functions for bitmap manipulation, iteration, logical operations, and memory management.

methods.name: struct:ewah_bitmap * ewah_new(void)
methods.description: Creates and initializes a new ewah_bitmap instance with default buffer size.

methods.name: void ewah_free(struct ewah_bitmap * self)
methods.description: Frees the memory associated with an ewah_bitmap instance.

methods.name: size_t ewah_add(struct ewah_bitmap * self,eword_t word)
methods.description: Adds a single word to the bitmap; handles literal and empty words efficiently.

methods.name: void ewah_set(struct ewah_bitmap * self,size_t i)
methods.description: Sets a specified bit in the bitmap, expanding the bitmap as necessary.

methods.name: void ewah_each_bit(struct ewah_bitmap * self,void (* callback)(size_t,void *),void * payload)
methods.description: Iterates over each set bit in the bitmap, invoking a callback for each.

methods.name: void ewah_iterator_init(struct ewah_iterator * it,struct ewah_bitmap * parent)
methods.description: Initializes an iterator to go over the bits in a bitmap.

methods.name: int ewah_iterator_next(eword_t * next,struct ewah_iterator * it)
methods.description: Advances the iterator to the next word, returning whether a word was retrieved.

methods.name: void ewah_or_iterator_init(struct ewah_or_iterator * it,struct ewah_bitmap ** parents,size_t nr)
methods.description: Initializes an iterator that performs a logical OR over multiple bitmaps.

methods.name: int ewah_or_iterator_next(eword_t * next,struct ewah_or_iterator * it)
methods.description: Retrieves the next combined word from multiple bitmaps via OR operation.

methods.name: void ewah_or_iterator_release(struct ewah_or_iterator * it)
methods.description: Frees resources held by an OR iterator.

methods.name: struct:ewah_bitmap * ewah_pool_new(void)
methods.description: Provides a new or pooled ewah_bitmap instance for reuse.

methods.name: void ewah_pool_free(struct ewah_bitmap * self)
methods.description: Returns a bitmap to the pool for possible reuse.

methods.name: uint32_t ewah_checksum(struct ewah_bitmap * self)
methods.description: Computes a checksum of the bitmap's buffer for integrity verification.
